entityDescription:
Wetlands and coastal ecosystems such as mangroves provide climate, biodiversity and social impacts, however typical restoration approaches are limited in scale and lack finance. On the other hand, larger corporations are looking for ways not just to become climate neutral but nature positive, with the recent Science Based Targets Network and the TNFD providing frameworks for this transition. With recent controversies around carbon credits, there is a demand for highly credible and meaningful impact data from contributions, not only on carbon but also biodiversity. We form a bridge between local wetland restoration projects and corporate ESG contributions through high quality data.
We do this through custom built tools such as specialised attachments for drones, which empower local groups to collect meaningful and holistic data streams on carbon, biodiversity and even social impacts. We help to fund the restoration and conservation efforts of these local groups, providing them the tools needed to collect the data at a quality that meets the demands of corporate contributors. This data is then disaggregated into specific 3x3 parcels of land which customers support through a subscription model, subscribing to impact and these meaningful data streams.

entityDescription:
Some of the hardest problems decision-makers face involve understanding large, complex systems such as economies, infrastructure, biological processes and human behaviour. Such systems, and the interrelationships and interdependencies between them, display emergent complexity and cannot therefore be fully understood through analysing past data or machine learning alone. To truly understand these problems we must recreate them through large scale simulations of the real world. 
Improbable’s Skyral platform technology and approach enables simulations of an unprecedented­ scale, empowering decision makers to answer “what if?” questions. These simulations are able to display emergent behaviour, leading to unexpected events and multi­order consequences that had previously been impossible to explore. This can be combined with live operational data to both improve model performance, provide a recognised ground picture within the joint operations area, provide support to battlespace management and drive after action review.

Improbable’s mission is to transform the way governments plan, execute and assess critical aspects of their nations’ governance, safety and security. Improbable provides a technology which is entirely unique in the market and the solution provides the means to improve situational awareness and decision-making processes, whilst enabling insight into the cascading consequences of actions and, in doing so, help decision makers to thrive in complexity in a way that cannot be adequately represented with existing capabilities. This will enable better appreciation of consequences intended and unintended; represent the complexity of the contemporary multi-domain operating environment; support the ability to plan against sub-threshold threats and enable interoperability by design.

entityDescription:
The TreeMap, is a geospatial company established in 2020. With headquarters in France and a significant presence in Jakarta, we are a passionate team of conservationists and scientists committed to preserving tropical forests. Our approach combines scientific investigations and advanced monitoring solutions utilizing satellite technology. We aim to uncover the underlying causes of deforestation and forest fires, evaluate the effectiveness of conservation projects and regulations, and advocate for sustainable practices in agriculture, timber, and mining industries. Transparency is at the core of our philosophy, and we make our scientific products and monitoring platform, the Nusantara Atlas: https://nusantara-atlas.org/ open access. It serves as a comprehensive resource for tracking deforestation and fires related to the palm oil and pulp-and-paper industries in Indonesia and Malaysia.
While Nusantara Atlas is open source, we recognize the need to address our client's specific requirements, including the integration of confidential data that they may prefer to keep private. We are dedicated to continuously enhancing the platform with new functionalities to meet evolving needs. To sustain and support these extended features, we offer an annual subscription model. Clients subscribing to Nusantara Atlas gain access to its enhanced capabilities, empowering them to fully leverage the platform for their projects and initiatives. In addition to the platform, we provide valuable services to companies, NGOs, governments, and research centres. These include API development, offering direct access to our deforestation data through application programming interfaces, with a corresponding subscription fee. We also provide technical consulting services, drawing upon our expertise in deforestation, forest fire mapping and interpretation, protected area and conservation project performance, and predictive deforestation models. Furthermore, we engage in research and development activities, constantly pushing the boundaries in forest and fire mapping, crop mapping, and their implications for forests. Please feel free to explore our list of publications for further information: https://thetreemap.com/publications

We also provide technical consulting services, drawing upon our expertise in deforestation, forest fire mapping and interpretation, protected area and conservation project performance, and predictive deforestation models. Furthermore, we engage in research and development activities, constantly pushing the boundaries in forest and fire mapping, crop mapping, and their implications for forests. Please feel free to explore our list of publications for further information: https://thetreemap.com/publications

entityDescription:
Televes is a leading global company focused in the design, development and manufacture of Telecommunications and IT products and solutions for building, smart cities, hospitality and home infrastructures, that will enable all present and future services.
Founded in 1958, the company is headquartered in Santiago de Compostela (Spain), where it keeps its state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities. A key signature trade of the company, Televes believes in delivering superior quality products through an exquisite manufacturing process.
Nowadays Televes is much more than a leading brand. It is the head of a Corporation comprised of strategic technological firms with a commercial presence in more than 100 countries. Televes is formed by 21 industrial and services subsidiaries, over 700 employees and holds more than 200 Industrial Property registers (European Patents, National Patents and Utility Models).
With nearly 60 years of experience, Televes has launched more than 1,500 different products, an achievement explained by the authentic passion for manufacturing. The company manufactures in its own facilities to guarantee maximum quality. It's also a pioneer in setting up 4.0 production lines with its own certification and quality control laboratories. In this way, our products proudly display the European Technology Made in Europe label.

Our core experience and expertise lie in supporting businesses to access public funding and providing technical assistance to public administration at the local, regional and central level.
